name: Xuanzang departs Chang'an for India
summary: Buddhist monk Xuanzang leaves the Tang capital in defiance of an imperial travel ban to seek authentic Sanskrit sources of Mahayana doctrine. Travels via the northern Silk Road through Turfan, Kucha, Samarkand, and Bactria, then crosses the Hindu Kush into Gandhara and the Ganges plain.

_quarry.structural_significance: Most consequential Buddhist pilgrimage of the Tang era; the textual foundation of Faxiang (East Asian Yogacara) Buddhism on his return.
